searchText: is there an article somewhere on the easiest way to setup a node in the cloud? stereum seems nice, but it doesn't really work, tons of bugs i'd ask in ethstaker, https://discord.gg/SS46GPct https://cryptoleaks.info/case-no-3 during the call a week or so ago, there was concern (I think from Micah?) about whether or not to ship MEV-boost as a part of the merge. since the clients have already delivered their merge-ready versions, I assume a choice has been made here? Even by the time the call happened there were non-censoring relays available so there wasn't really a question of not including support left, mostly just comment on the importance of censorship resistance and some discussion around what the threshold may be to manually slash validators who censor. I see. Thank you!
